text:
Asha (CSM): Quick capture — PulseWave just finished their onboarding. They sent a short list of asks and a few pain notes. Need triage + product prioritization before renewal check-in next month. TL;DR: (1) per-route billing toggle (enable/disable route-level cost view), (2) bulk export of flagged customer feedback as CSV, (3) embedding cache controls (TTL + invalidate) for lower latency on repeated queries. Also: they reported noisy fallback behavior when a model variant fails (retries spike costs).

Priya (PM): thanks Asha. Can you paste the raw request or screenshot? we'll need repro steps for the fallback spikes. For prioritization: what's the business impact + frequency? top3 please.

Asha (CSM): paste of their note below (redacted):
> "We need a per-route cost toggle so our finance team can hide token-level cost except on demand. Right now it's everywhere and it confuses non-technical stakeholders."
> "CSV export of flagged feedback per project would help our product team ingest into their tracker."
> "Cache controls: some queries are repeated with same prompts, but after a deploy cache seems to flush unpredictably."

Gabe (CS-OPS): adding quick telemetry: PulseWave has ~120k tokens/day, 18% of those hit fallback path in the past week (mostly during 03:00–05:00 UTC retries). I'm worried the retry logic currently ramps concurrency which multiplies cost.

Jared (Eng): per-route billing toggle — if routes already have metadata we can add a UI switch and filter in the billing export. Backend work: add boolean flag on Route, wiring to billing exporter + UI toggle. Rough estimate: 3–5 dev days + 1 QA sprint. Low risk.

Priya (PM): CSV export: is this just exporting flagged messages? need the exact schema PulseWave wants. Asha — can you ask for their required fields (timestamp, route, user id, snippet, tags)?

Lena (Support): they sent this sample CSV header in the ticket:
```
project,route,user_id,timestamp,flag_reason,transcript_snippet,model_variant
pulsewave,route-A,usr_123,2026-03-15T21:12:00Z,privacy_flag,"customer asked to redact PII",gptx-legacy
```

Asha (CSM): filed that sample to the shared ticket. Also they called out "no clear way to invalidate embedding cache per-project when training new embeddings" — sounds like we should add a per-project TTL and a manual invalidate button in Console.

Priya (PM): prioritization suggestion from product side: 1) per-route billing toggle (low dev cost, high customer satisfaction / renewal signal), 2) CSV export of flagged feedback (medium effort, enables customer workflows), 3) embedding cache controls (higher design surface, but important for model retrain workflows), 4) fallback retry behavior (ops + infra; medium urgency because of cost spikes). Thoughts?

Gabe (CS-OPS): agree on order, but move fallback retry up if we see cost spikes continue. Can we add a short metric alert for >10% fallback rate in a 6h window?

Jared (Eng): I can scope fallback mitigation: short-term — cap retries per-request and exponential backoff; medium-term — circuit-breaker per model-variant. Short-term estimate: 2 dev days + monitoring rule.

Asha (CSM): perfect. Action items I captured:
- Asha: request exact CSV fields + acceptance criteria from PulseWave (by EOD).
- Priya: create PRD stub and cost/effort estimate for toggle + CSV (this week).
- Jared: quick mitigation for retries + monitoring alert (POC by next Tues).
- Gabe: add alert rule to ops dashboard (>10% fallback 6h).
- Lena: confirm sample CSV ingestion flow for their product team.

comms-bot: Created ticket: CS-3427 "PulseWave: billing toggle + feedback export + cache controls" (<https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3427>).

Priya (PM): I'll schedule a 30min sync with PulseWave stakeholders next Wed. Asha — can you invite engineering and ops?

Asha (CSM): will do. Also attaching the snippet of their Slack DM where they mentioned renewal concerns: "If we can't show clearer billing, renewals will be at risk next quarter." We should surface this in the renewal deck.

Lena (Support): noted — prepping a short export demo showing current vs proposed CSV fields for the sync.

Jared (Eng): quick code note for the team on retry cap (copy-paste for ticket):
```
// pseudo
if (fallbackCount > 2) {
  return error("fallback_limit_reached");
}
retryWithBackoff();
```

Gabe (CS-OPS): tagging @priya and @jared — I'll instrument the fallback metric and add it to the sprint board.

Asha (CSM): Thanks all — goal is to have PRD + ticket triage done before the renewal check-in on 2026-04-06. :thumbsup:

Priya (PM): noted — will post progress updates in the ticket thread and here.

Lena (Support): +1, will have sample export ready for demo.

(comms-bot): Ticket CS-3427 moved to "In Progress" by Priya.
